cloud9-zfs-rehab-collector.timer.original:
[Unit]
Description=Refresh cloud_arezki ZFS rehabilitation dashboard every 5 seconds

[Timer]
OnBootSec=8s
OnUnitActiveSec=5s
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=cloud9-zfs-rehab-collector.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

cloud9-operations-collector.timer.original:
[Unit]
Description=Refresh Cloud9 operations telemetry every 8 seconds
[Timer]
OnBootSec=8s
OnUnitActiveSec=8s
AccuracySec=2s
Unit=cloud9-operations-collector.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

cloud9-pbs-check-verification.timer.original:
[Unit]
Description=Recheck PBS native snapshot verification every 15 minutes
[Timer]
OnBootSec=5min
OnUnitActiveSec=15min
AccuracySec=45s
Unit=cloud9-pbs-check-verification.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

cloud9-zfs-rehab-next-stage.timer.original:
[Unit]
Description=Evaluate post-ZFS-scrub safety and start PBS only when clean

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitActiveSec=60s
AccuracySec=2s
Unit=cloud9-zfs-rehab-next-stage.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
cloud9-zfs-rehab-next-stage.timer.new: disabled after completed scrub and confirmed successful native four-cloud backups
